name: Background Atmospheres
description: A carousel of 8 calming atmospheres — 5 full-motion videos (Beach, River, Fireplace, Earth, Space) and 3 photos (Seashore, Countryside, Rainforest) — plus the ability to import your own media from your device library.

name: Breathing Rhythms
description: Four presets — Balance (5/5), Relax (4/6), Energy (6/4), and Sleep (4/7/8) — plus fully configurable custom inhale, hold, and exhale timings for building your own rhythm.

name: Offline-First Media
description: Every background atmosphere downloads once and plays fully offline afterward, with download prompts, progress indicators, and status icons so sessions never depend on a live connection.

name: Advanced Session Options
description: Fine-tune each session with controls for duration, soundtrack, and on-device storage management, so the app fits the exact ritual you want without extra clutter for everyone else.

name: Privacy-First, No Accounts
description: No accounts, no sign-ins, no analytics, and no ad or tracking SDKs — breathing settings and downloaded media stay entirely on your device.

name: 27 Languages
description: The app and site are available in 27 languages, making guided breathing practice accessible to a global audience without translation friction.
